content: यातनम् .²1 Return, requital, recompense, retaliation; as in वैरयातनम्. .²2 Vengeance, revenge. .{@-ना@} .²1 Requital, recompense, return. .²2 Torment, acute pain, anguish. .²3 The torments inflicted by Yama upon sinners, the tortures of hell (<ab>pl.</ab>) ˚अर्थीय destined to suffer the torments of hell; शरीरं यातनार्थीयम् <ls>Ms. 12. 16</ls>. ˚गृहः torture-chamber.
